title: Chapter 1205 - 21 Killer Move ’Fierce Sun Fall’ (Seeking Subscription)
content:
Chapter 1205 - 21 Killer Move ’Fierce Sun Fall’ (Seeking Subscription)

Chapter 1205: Chapter 21 Killer Move ’Fierce Sun Fall’ (Seeking Subscription)

Lin Yuan slightly studied the golden mist and discovered its extraordinary nature.

The golden mist appeared cloud-like and could be captured and confined, but Lin Yuan could not touch it.

"Unable to touch?"

Lin Yuan’s gaze was curious; the Divine Ability ’World’ operated constantly, with layers of time and space under his control, yet he couldn’t truly make contact with the golden mist.

"Interesting."

Lin Yuan extended his right hand, ready to take all the golden mist in the valley.

To ensure the golden mist wasn’t damaged, Lin Yuan even moved the entire valley into his internal universe.

"It should be related to time."

Lin Yuan looked at the golden mist and thought to himself.

He could sense slight time fluctuations emanating from the golden mist, and coupled with the time reversal area outside the treasure site, it was almost certain that this newly emerged first-class treasure site was inclined towards time attributes.

In fact, various ancient countries also speculated that the miraculous treasures born here would be related to time.

"Should I attempt a soul and mind probe?"

Lin Yuan pondered silently.

Many of the miraculous treasures birthed from treasure sites must be absorbed and devoured through special means.

For instance, the Hei Yu Nest’s Hei Yu can only be refined with the will of the mind, as for others? There was simply no reaction.

"Forget it, it’s too risky."

After a brief contemplation, Lin Yuan abandoned this idea.

The soul and mind are too important; what if this golden miraculous treasure has some side effects or harm on them? It would be courting disaster.

Lin Yuan dared to refine Hei Yu with his will because the Hei Yu Nest had existed for countless eons, and the miraculous Hei Yu it nurtured had refining methods verified by numerous Heavenly Venerates, ensuring no hidden dangers.

And this golden mist? Who knows what effects it might have.

Lin Yuan had no need to rush.

If he could acquire the golden mist within this valley, the Peak Venerables of other ancient countries surely could as well.

Compared to the experienced Peak Venerables of the six ancient countries, Lin Yuan reckoned it better to wait for the correct method of using the golden mist to be discovered before trying it himself.

"Continue to search for the core pillar."

Lin Yuan did not linger long in front of the valley and, after collecting all the golden mist, continued to explore in the directed path.

Fierce Sun capital, isolated space.

Red Lotus Venerable opened his eyes once more: "I’ve found another core pillar."

With these words.

The surrounding Peak Venerables all turned to look at him.

Within the treasure site, searching for core pillars truly depended on luck.

Red Lotus Venerable’s probing skills weren’t strong among the twelve Peak Venerables, but the number of core Venerables he found ranked in the top five, even top three.

"Where is it located?"

"You refine the outer part first."

Red Flame Venerable said.

While it’s true that core pillars are usually left for the top-tier Peak Venerables to refine, if they haven’t arrived yet, surely the Peak Venerable who found it first would start refining a part.

"It’s here."

Red Lotus Venerable immediately provided a coordinate, his expression suddenly changing: "Other ancient countries’ Peak Venerables are coming; it’s the Peak Venerable from Da Fu Ancient Country."

"Peak Venerable from Da Fu Ancient Country?"

Red Flame Venerable frowned, immediately asking: "Which Peak Venerable is it?"

If it were a top-tier Peak Venerable, Red Flame Venerable would suggest Red Lotus Venerable yield that core pillar.

It wasn’t about fearing Da Fu Ancient Country, but with Red Lotus Venerable’s strength, he wouldn’t last long before a top-tier Peak Venerable from Da Fu Ancient Country.

Unless Red Lotus Venerable, like Lin Yuan, hid the strength of a top-tier Peak Venerable, but that possibility was too low.

"It’s Fu Dang Venerate."

Red Lotus Venerable quickly responded.

Da Fu Ancient Country had sent twelve Peak Venerables, all of whom he understood well, even if they hadn’t crossed paths; he had also seen detailed intelligence on them.

"Fu Dang Venerate?"

Red Flame Venerable felt assured.

Among the twelve Peak Venerables of Da Fu Ancient Country, Fu Dang Venerate’s strength was mid-level, close to the top-tier Peak Venerable tier; stronger than Red Lotus Venerable but not by much.

"Guard the core pillar."

Red Flame Venerable said.

Though Da Fu Ancient Country was powerful, it didn’t mean Fierce Sun Ancient Country feared them. Unless it was Fu Xu Venerate or a few top-tier Peak Venerables, Fierce Sun Ancient Country had no reason to retreat.

Involving the ownership of this first-class treasure site, with a chance of winning, they had to contend.

"Alright."

Red Lotus Venerable nodded.

Although Fu Dang Venerate was stronger, it wasn’t about winning or losing against him; merely holding him off, Red Lotus Venerable was confident enough.

"This location..."

Red Flame Venerable looked towards Lin Yuan: "Galaxy, among the four of us, you are closest to this location; next up, it’s on you."

"Understood."

Lin Yuan nodded.

As one of the only four top-tier Peak Venerables in Fierce Sun Ancient Country, Lin Yuan also bore the task of refining the core pillar.

If other Peak Venerables of Fierce Sun Ancient Country discovered a core pillar close to him, Lin Yuan needed to make a trip.

...

"Where is Red Lotus there?"

Within the treasure site, Lin Yuan suddenly stopped and looked in another direction from afar.

Swish!

The next moment.

Lin Yuan’s figure vanished, and it was only moments later that space-time rippled.

Normally when searching for the core pillar, one would have to fly and search slowly.

But to quickly reach a certain coordinate, naturally, one would travel directly through the void.

...

The majestic pillar seemed illusory.

Red Lotus Venerable stood before the pillar, looking solemn, with scarlet lotus flames burning around him.

"Red Lotus, yield this core pillar."
